name: pdschain-v2
description: PDSChain v2 — Blockchain-based Public Distribution System Monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@pdschain/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@pdschain/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@pdschain/api && npm run build --workspace=@pdschain/web && npm run compile --workspace=@pdschain/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pdschain/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pdschain/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pdschain/contracts
scripts.test: npm run db:start && npm test --workspace=@pdschain/api && npm test --workspace=@pdschain/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:start && node scripts/db-migrate.mjs deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run db:start && node scripts/db-migrate.mjs dev
scripts.db:status: npm run db:start && node scripts/db-migrate.mjs status
